## Changes
Addresses the bounded source/presentation facets of the remaining 18 findings across saved client details and intake, facilities/activity/files, Calendar lifecycle and selected-artifact sharing, rich mail composition, capabilities, shared meeting detail, task grouping and public forms. Preserves one Next application and the existing shared session/client boundary, fixed operation gateway, Core/Intel separation and Meri public package contracts.

Source frozen at `104495d4cdc8251640b922aea431fa0e169fe935`; application tree `ad282f731750e1984790de2ec266ff9e311581c9`. This is a successor to draft PR14; its source and evidence remain intact. Owner deliveries, original assertions and failing regression attempts are preserved. Exact responsibility reviews cover source and test size signals without relaxing guards.

## Qualification status
Clean install and combined public-package/type/test/architecture/transport/lint/format/unit gate passed on the frozen source. The initial install failed on an unavailable default npm cache path; the unchanged-source retry with the writable Capiro cache passed. Inherited 76 lint warnings and 24 architecture findings remain explicitly recorded.

On source104495d, 1,471 combined checks, 15 Elements checks, the Next production build, actual standalone server checks (11 HTTP/4 renderings/2 history cases) and all208 Modules browser cases passed. The1,118-case Portfolio browser run was stopped after163 passes and7 attendance helper failures: upcoming meetings now intentionally enter Preparation, while the older helper expected Information. Three cases were interrupted and945 did not run. Original failures are preserved; a minimal navigation/read-fixture correction is under review with every attendance assertion retained. A fresh exact-source qualification will follow. Meri coverage includes its9 workspace Node controls,21 public transport controls, assets and actual/shared-mode navigation; no full native Meri interaction claim is made.

This draft is **not combined-qualified**. Final evidence and exact gate results will follow; do not infer acceptance from this draft or mergeability.

All 337 native Portfolio rows remain unaccepted. Live identity/native persistence/provider execution, full Figma fidelity and shipping remain open. There is no verified complete immutable Figma backup in GitHub: edit a duplicate while retaining original file Zc2dEN5aLU47dVdsewDmiJ, page/node411:40601 and linked libraries unchanged.

No merge, deployment, resources, credentials, security/database change, real provider message, billing or paid model workload is included.
